# Chronometer (`watchClock`)

A fine wristwatch dial: sunburst finish, polished hands, a sweeping seconds hand.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: medium (~3.1 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Chronometer

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dial` | Dial | menu | 0 Black · 1 Blue · 2 Silver · 3 Green · 4 Champagne | 1 (Blue) |
| `date` | Date Window | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `seconds` | Seconds | menu | 0 Sweep · 1 Off | 0 (Sweep) |
| `lume` | Lume | menu | 0 Glow at Night · 1 Off | 0 (Glow at Night) |
